ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Child Process of AspNetCompiler
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of "aspnet_compiler.exe".

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\aspnet\\_compiler\\\.exe$") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\notepad\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*"))))
